enunciado: Define the interfaces Flyer (fly()) and Swimmer (swim()). Duck implements both, Plane only Flyer and Fish only Swimmer. Go through an array of Flyer and another of Swimmer.
objetivos: Implement several interfaces in one class
Group objects by capability, not by inheritance
pistas: An interface only declares abstract methods.
A Duck can be stored both in a Flyer array and in a Swimmer array.
